topLine: Physicist and AI bootstrap an exact solution to the 1D frustrated Potts model.

items.headline: Physicist and AI bootstrap an exact solution to the 1D frustrated Potts model
items.summary: Brookhaven theorist Weiguo Yin used OpenAI's o3-mini-high to help solve the one-dimensional frustrated Potts model with next-nearest-neighbour interactions for any number of spin orientations, a decades-old statistical-mechanics problem. Published in Physical Review B: the model exploited symmetry to crack the three-orientation case in about a day while also making frequent errors; Yin blocked the wrong steps and wrote the rigorous general proof himself.
